quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete A-B-C-D and roll through the lit yellow lanes to advance 2x, 3x, then 5x.

quickInfo.name: Bonus collect
quickInfo.summary: The lit upper-left saucer collects base bonus times Bonus X and preserves the multiplier for the ball.

quickInfo.name: Upgraded drop bank
quickInfo.summary: After one full bank completion, every reset target in that bank scores 5,000 for the ball.

quickInfo.name: Extra Ball targets
quickInfo.summary: Complete both drop banks to alternate the Extra Ball lamp between the two center standups.

steps.text: Read whether the copy uses three-ball or five-ball rules and identify the lit top letters.
Use the upper flippers as live shots through the narrow center gates to return the ball to A-B-C-D.
Complete A-B-C-D without forcing a dangerous letter and watch which yellow multiplier lane lights.
Roll through each lit yellow lane to reach at least 3x, and continue to 5x while the feed is safe.
modeNotes: Bonus X: Lit yellow lanes advance 2x, 3x, then 5x; later lit lanes score 15,000 without another multiplier step.

steps.text: Hit targets and roll through the top lanes, upper side lanes, and upper-flipper return lanes until Base Bonus reaches 20,000.
Shoot the upper-left saucer when its collect lamp is lit.
modeNotes: Bonus collect: A 20,000 base scores 60,000 at 3x or 100,000 at 5x; the collect resets base bonus but preserves Bonus X.

steps.text: Use the lit lower inlanes after the collect, rebuild base bonus with the safer drop bank, and repeat the saucer.
Protect the current multiplier before the drain because Bonus X resets each ball.

fallback.title: Recovery: Upgraded drop-bank value
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the upper gates or saucer are unreliable.

steps.text: Choose the drop bank with the safer rebound.
Complete the bank and confirm that it resets.
Repeat targets in a completed bank for 5,000 each and build Base Bonus.
Return to the saucer after Bonus X reaches at least 3x.
Stop the bank route when rebounds reach the outlanes.

alternatives.title: Position play: Maximum bonus route
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this when top feeds and the saucer remain controlled.

steps.text: Complete A-B-C-D and use lit yellow lanes to reach 5x.
Score targets, top lanes, upper side lanes, and upper-flipper return lanes until Base Bonus reaches 20,000.
Collect 100,000 at the upper-left saucer.
Rebuild the bonus with 5x preserved and collect again.

alternatives.title: Extra Ball route
alternatives.when: Use this only when the award has tournament value.

steps.text: Complete both drop banks.
Identify the lit one of the two center standups.
Shoot only that target from control and prepare for the rebound.
Stop when settings replace Extra Ball with a low point award.
Complete the top letters and use each lit yellow lane.
Reach 5x Bonus X.
Score targets, top lanes, upper side lanes, and upper-flipper return lanes until Base Bonus reaches 20,000.
Collect 100,000 at the lit upper-left saucer.
Rebuild and repeat before the multiplier resets at drain.

playfieldReferences.label: Bonus collect saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Upper-left saucer used to collect the built base bonus.
playfieldReferences.context: Collect the built bonus at the upper-left saucer.

techniques.name: Upper-gate return
techniques.instruction: Use an upper flipper to send the ball through a narrow center gate and back to the A-B-C-D lanes.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Use a small early nudge to move the ball from the bottom post toward the lower return lane.

techniques.name: Cradle
techniques.instruction: Shoot immediately from an upper flipper because its shape does not permit a normal cradle.

cautions.issue: The center standups have severe rebounds.
cautions.response: Avoid the center standups until Extra Ball is lit. Then shoot the center standup whose Extra Ball lamp is lit, only from a controlled ball.

cautions.issue: Most upper-playfield contacts can return without control.
cautions.response: Read each feed before you repeat it; the saucer is the most predictable upper return.

cautions.issue: The center bumper can send the ball to either outlane.
cautions.response: Use an early nudge and stop after the lane is committed.

cautions.issue: A large upper-outlane post save can overcorrect into the lower outlane.
cautions.response: Use one small early move instead of a late hard nudge.
